definitions.explanation: Drawing back out of fear, reluctance, or intimidation. The image is of sitting back on one's heels ({尻|しり} = buttocks) to avoid moving forward.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}を{見|み}て{尻込|しりご}みした。
examples.english: I flinched when I saw the price.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しそうで{尻込|しりご}みしてしまう。
examples.english: It looks difficult, so I end up shrinking back.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}の{前|まえ}で{話|はな}すのは{緊張|きんちょう}するが、{尻込|しりご}みしていては{成長|せいちょう}できない。
examples.english: Speaking in front of a large audience is nerve-racking, but you can't grow if you keep shrinking back.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as {尻込|しりご}みする. Implies a physical or psychological drawing back from something intimidating. The compound comes from {尻|しり} (buttocks) + {込|こ}む (to go into), evoking the image of sitting back in retreat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尻込|しりご}みする: to flinch, to shrink back
- {尻込|しりご}みしてしまう: to end up hesitating
- {尻込|しりご}みせずに: without flinching
